issues.fix: Add `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'` before `$c = $Host.UI.PromptForCredential(...)` (or check `if (-not $?) { exit 1 }` right after it) so a failed `PromptForCredential` call exits non-zero and surfaces stderr to `dialog_windows.go`.
issues.problem: In Windows PowerShell 5.1, a .NET method exception thrown by `$Host.UI.PromptForCredential(...)` is a statement-terminating (not script-terminating) error under the default `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'`. Execution continues to `if ($c) { ... }` on line 95, which evaluates cleanly with `$c` unset and resets `$?` to `$true`, causing `powershell.exe -Command` to exit 0 with empty stdout. `dialog_windows.go` then maps that to `ErrCancelled` instead of reporting the failure.
